description: Academic and scientific paper search & DOI citation lookup across 250M+ works via OpenAlex (titles, authors, venues, citation counts, open-access PDF URLs, and abstracts). $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

limit.description: Optional max papers to return (1-20, default 10).

q.description: Research topic search query (2-200 chars). Pass q OR doi.

sort.description: Optional sort: relevance (default), cited, or recent.

name: paper_search
title: Paper search
